headline: Central Fronts Churn as Dead Lands Casualties Mount Rapidly
war_summary: Base contestation over the past three hours remained concentrated along the central and northern seams, led by continuous territorial trades across Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow. In Weathered Expanse, where six base events transpired in the last two hours, neutral ground persists around Crow's Nest and shattered redoubts even as casualty rates moderate. Marban Hollow sustained five recent shifts focused on Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, leaving two positions unoccupied. Concurrently, Kuura Strand and Nevish Line posted further tactical realignments, with Nevish Line noting a sharp resurgence in hourly casualties exceeding four hundred combined losses. The most drastic change since the morning bulletin occurred in the Dead Lands, where intense combat suddenly erupted to claim over twelve hundred casualties across two hours despite no direct base ownership flips. Conversely, fighting subsided markedly in Linn of Mercy and Callahan's Passage, both cooling to negligible losses following earlier heavy exchanges. Outlying sectors across the southern rim and island networks remain tranquil under firm Colonial administration.
